protocol.question_template: What sensitive sink is reachable from {entrypoint}?
protocol.cases: All expected positive paths in the existing 11-case seeded corpus; negative cases have no target pair and are excluded.
protocol.ranking: Unchanged category, lexical-overlap, and kind bonus from grounded.py; ties by kind then title.
protocol.metric: Both expected endpoint and sink label occur in returned evidence, case-insensitive substring matching as in the corpus. This does not validate their relationship.
protocol.secondary_metric: A single returned path citation contains both labels. This directly measures path availability, not independent correctness.
protocol.scope: Descriptive ablation on seeded examples, not held-out retrieval evaluation, LLM evaluation, or comparison against another tool.
